title: Feta, Kashkaval and Roasted Vegetable Quiche
subtitle: with a buttery shortcrust base
description: A quiche with a buttery shortcrust base, layered with kashkaval, roasted capsicum, sweet potato and zucchini, then topped with feta and a creamy egg custard.

steps.text: Process the flour, sugar, salt and cold cubed butter in a food processor until fine crumbs form. Add the vinegar and 1 egg and process to coarse crumbs. Gather into a ball of dough, wrap in cling film and chill for 1 hour.

Preheat the oven to 180°C. Roll the dough on a lightly floured surface into a 27 cm round, 3-4 mm thick. Line the base and sides of a tart tin and trim the excess. Top with pie weights or beans so the base doesn't puff up.
Bake for 10 minutes, remove the weights and bake for about 5 minutes more until the pastry dries out.
Place the capsicum strips, sliced sweet potato and zucchini strips in a tray, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper and bake for about 20 minutes until tender. Let cool.
Whisk the remaining 2 eggs with the cream, salt and pepper.
Scatter the grated kashkaval over the part-baked pastry, arrange the roasted vegetables on top, pour over the egg mixture and sprinkle with the feta.
Bake for 35-45 minutes until golden and set. Rest for about 10 minutes before slicing.
